about: Mesa's zero-intelligence double auction: bids and asks as lists of Order dataclasses, the best by max or min with a key, try_match one cross, clear_all_crosses a loop over try_match

lines: # gdp: law the best bid fills: forall o in old(self.bids): forall j in old(self.bids): o in self.bids or o.price > j.price or (o.price == j.price and o.timestamp <= j.timestamp)
# gdp: law the best ask fills: forall o in old(self.asks): forall j in old(self.asks): o in self.asks or o.price < j.price or (o.price == j.price and o.timestamp <= j.timestamp)
# gdp: law a fill crosses: forall b in old(self.bids): forall a in old(self.asks): b in self.bids or a in self.asks or a.price <= b.price
# gdp: law the earliest to arrive at the best price fills: forall o in old(self.asks): forall j in old(self.asks): o in self.asks or o.price < j.price or (o.price == j.price and o <= j)
# gdp: law no agent trades with itself: forall b in old(self.bids): forall a in old(self.asks): b in self.bids or a in self.asks or b.agent_id != a.agent_id
